tasks.brief:
Task T5 - UHPC Stage 3, part a: split, build, check, store. Specification: the plan section '### T5' and the contract items T5 implements (S8, F9, F10, the modular-precast F14, the S8 schema) and consumes (F1-F7, through the SK stand-ins in tests/standins until J1). Owner decisions that bind you (AGENTS section 3 items 4, 7, 16, 25-35): Stage 3 starts from the whole Stage-2 solution with the split V_UHPC,i = V_i (rho_i - rho_air)/(rho_UHPC - rho_air); the shell above the ballast in the ballast module is a variable t_k* >= t_min, started at t_min; flotation is an equality held to the solver's constraint tolerance; the mass_acceptable_pct check on Z_CG = CG_total(3), GM, coupled T_heave and coupled T_pitch decides accepted or failed; never fall back to Stage 2; delete the pre-check (deletion register D16). Base b4523aa holds T0, T1, T9, T0b, T0c, SK and the merged contract. Shared files (contract section 4): if a row lists an earlier task not merged into your base (for example build_config.m and WEC_User_Input.m wait for T0d, T4a and T4b), do not edit that file now; implement and test everything else and record the exact deferred edit (file, function, change) under 'deferred' in your report; it becomes your last commit at the J2 merge. Test on the SK cylinder and box with sti_stage2 and sti_config (closed forms); no whole-pipeline run.

Orchestrator decisions on the round-4 spec issues (binding for implementer and grader):
(a) F10 pass = the four metrics and flotation, as T5 implements. AGENTS section 3 item 27 and section 5 item 11 on main now say so (owner's words, items 4.4 and 32): the GM equality steers the solve and its residual is reported beside the check without entering it. Keep T5's rule; the SK stand-in is aligned separately.
(b) F11 out_dir is the type folder, mwecmass.output.output_dir(type); export_stage3 (T10, accepted) writes into its 'step' subfolder itself. modular_precast/run.m now passes fullfile(output_dir('modular_precast'), 'step'), which would write into step/step: pass output_dir('modular_precast'). This is an added required fix.
(c) A module whose t_min shell exceeds its V_uhpc split is reported in the printed Stage-3 log; S8 gets no new field.
(d) The knot-structure restart that stops on a repeated structure with a note stands.
(e) Per-module t_max,i, F6 caching and catching kernel errors as failed evaluations are T6 and T3 items: nothing for T5.

tasks.brief:
Task T6 - UHPC Stage 3, part b: optimisation, spill, closest fail. Specification: the plan section '### T6' and the contract items it implements and consumes; your base is T5's accepted branch. Owner decisions that bind you (AGENTS section 3 items 4-8, 15-17, 20, 25-35, section 5 item 11): objective = closeness to the Stage-2 solution, the sum of squared relative deviations of Z_CG, coupled T_heave and coupled T_pitch; equalities: flotation and GM = GM_Stage2; variables: ballast level in k*, t_k*, t_i of the hollow modules above k*, and the draft last; escalation: ballast within k*, then spill into k*+1 (same variable, upper bound widened to the top of k*+1), then the draft only when mass balance cannot be met at the Stage-2 draft, then closest fail. Status: accepted when flotation holds and the mass_acceptable_pct check (F10 pass: Z_CG, GM, T_heave, T_pitch and flotation) passes; the GM equality residual is reported beside the check without entering it; otherwise closest fail (the optimum if the equalities hold, else the iterate with the smallest equality violation), stored, reported per metric, plotted and exported like an accepted design.
Orchestrator decisions: (1) t_max,i per module = d_close(z_range of module i's hollow part) - eps_fit/2 from F2b (contract line 'Bounds: t_max,i (T6)'), not one hull-wide value: the neck limit applies only to the module that contains it. (2) Kernel errors that contract F5 and section 8 name (VoidClosed, JointNotNested, FitNotConverged) count as failed evaluations inside the optimisation, never abort Stage 3. (3) F11 out_dir is the type folder (T5 fixes run.m). Shared files: as in T5 (deferred edits go to J2). Test on stand-ins, including a forced-infeasible case and a spill case; no whole-pipeline run.

Task T7 - thin-shell rebuild on the kernel. Specification: the plan section '### T7' and the contract items T7 implements (the thin-shell F14) and consumes (F1-F7, F9, F10 through the SK stand-ins until the joins). Owner decisions that bind you (AGENTS section 3 items 11, 14, 17, 19-25, 30-32): a separate pipeline from UHPC (do not copy its logic); one uniform shell thickness t for the whole hull, t_min = t_init = 25.4 mm; z_ballast free to pass module edges without penalty; the draft only when mass balance cannot be met at the Stage-2 draft; equalities flotation and GM = GM_Stage2; objective = closeness to the Stage-2 solution (squared relative deviations of Z_CG, coupled T_heave, coupled T_pitch); t_max = half the thickness of the slender wall from F2b (contract: d_close - eps/2), with no height band or other number; closest-fail rule, never fall back to Stage 2; the steel shell sheet only from z_ballast up (OD3); delete D2, D4, D6, D7 per the plan. Base b4523aa holds T0, T1, T9, T0b, T0c, SK and the merged contract. Shared files (contract section 4): a row whose earlier task is not merged into your base (build_config.m and WEC_User_Input.m wait for T0d, T4a, T4b and T5) is not edited now; record the exact deferred edit under 'deferred'; it becomes your last commit at J2. Test on the SK stand-ins (closed forms); no whole-pipeline run.

Orchestrator decisions on the round-4 spec issues (binding for implementer and grader):
(a) F10 pass. AGENTS section 3 item 27 and section 5 item 11 now read (main, owner's words of items 4.4 and 32): the design is accepted when flotation holds and the mass_acceptable_pct check on Z_CG, GM, T_heave, T_pitch passes; the GM equality steers the solve and its residual is reported beside the check without entering it; otherwise closest fail. T5's real F10 implements exactly this (pass = four metrics and flotation). T7 sets status from check.pass and must not depend on the GM row entering pass; the SK stand-in F10 will be aligned separately. If a T7 test relies on the GM row entering pass, change it.
(b) F11 out_dir is the type folder (mwecmass.output.output_dir(type)); export_stage3 writes into its 'step' subfolder. T7 already does this.
(c) Thin-shell floors: T4b stores them in config.per_strip_density_lb, as T7 reads (deferred d6 stays).
(d) t_init: AGENTS section 3 item 19 (one user value) governs; your deferred d1-d3 stand, with correct line numbers.
(e) Spec issues on the precast path calling deleted thin-shell functions, F6 integral caching, and the S3/S8 NaN wording are J2 or T3 items: nothing for T7.

tasks.brief:
Task T8 - figures from the realised solid. Specification: the plan section '### T8' and the contract items T8 implements (F12, F13) and consumes (S4, S8 through the SK stand-in sti_realised, F6b, I3, section 4). Figures draw true sections of the realised solid and honour the ballast level (AGENTS section 5 item 6); a figure is judged by its section data (AGENTS section 1 rule 12): every drawn boundary has a face of the solid behind it, the drawn areas equal the body's section areas, the drawn ballast level equals z_ballast. Figure rendering is not run in Octave (AGENTS section 6); the F12 data are tested in Octave. Base b4523aa. You take over from earlier implementers: read the branch history and the current code first.

Orchestrator decisions on your spec issues: (a) extract_midplane_profile.m stays: its output config.profile feeds Stage 1 and contract F9 (final_props.cross_section); remove it from what T8 deletes (D13 then covers only the figure-only silhouette code). (b) The config.shell = [] assignment in build_config.m (D10) is not T8's: contract section 4 does not give T8 build_config.m; leave it and list it as deferred to T11. (c) Gate positions that come from the kernel's cut (ballast top, a void z_lo equal to z_ballast) at most with the contract's I3 bound or only on the stand-ins, and print the deviation. (d) Module edges: draw the void boundary only where the realised solid has one (merge abutting void polygons of consecutive modules; keep the precast joint_step), exposed in the F12 data so it is tested in Octave.
Orchestrator decisions on the round-8 spec issues: (e) Resolution: sample every height where the body has a face boundary (body.planes and the z ends of every face) plus the n_z cells; between two sampled heights of the same type a change is not resolved; state this limit in the docstring (it is the grader's rewording). (f) The dispatch.m F13 call is T8's edit, applied as T8's last commit at J2 after T4a merges: record the exact line-24 text the grader gives. (g) Replace the two-loop mock in tests/figures by one non-convex (U-shaped) inner loop per height, so the mock obeys M3 (one closed loop per void slice). (h) Before you report, test every topology change of the y = 0 cut of a void that a one-loop section allows, each with a mock and an exact area check: one interval to two and back (material island: one outline with one hole), one to two without rejoining inside the module, two to one; and run git status before each commit (no stray files).

tasks.brief: Task T0d - save and reload the geometry products of build_config (owner request). Specification: the plan section '### T0d' and the contract section 4 rows for build_config.m, WEC_User_Input.m, tests/run_tests.m and .gitignore (T0d may edit them now: the earlier tasks are merged). The fingerprint covers the .ms2 file bytes, every input field the cached steps read, and the source of every .m file they can call (whole folders are acceptable; a missing file is not); hash with java.security.MessageDigest (Octave uses the T0 shim). Store plain arrays and structs only. A reloaded config must equal a freshly built one (isequal), and changing the .ms2 file, any keyed input or any keyed source file must trigger a rebuild (one test each). Print the fresh-build time of build_config with the new parser (the 'after' value; T0 recorded 2,067 s under the profiler before T0c) and the load time. The MWEC_REGRESSION opt-in already exists in tests/run_tests.m. Every number stays identical; no whole-pipeline run.

Task T4a - Stage-2 changes that do not need the kernel. Specification: the plan section '### T4a' (deletion register D14, D15) and the contract section 4 rows it names; your base is T0d's accepted branch. Delete c_mono and c_mass_min in both copies (stage2_constraints.m and the Stage-1 surrogate solve_2d_surrogate.m), with rho_max where only c_mono used it, the monotonicity comments and the fallback sizes (owner: 'Delete c_mono'); add the bottom-filled second Stage-2 start (every module at its lower density bound, then modules filled to the mode's solid density from the keel up until mass = rho_w * V_sub; the UHPC wall module stays pinned), keep the start with the lower objective and log both; the upper density bound per mode from the material inputs (rho_ballast 7500 for thin shell, rho_uhpc 2500 for precast); thin-shell t_min = t_init = 0.0254 m. Stability stays enforced by GM >= gm_min. Run Stage 1 and Stage 2 only (not the whole pipeline) on C1 for both modes with the cached config; print both starts, the optimum, exit flags, and check the formulation directly at the returned point (constraints and the flotation equality); Octave results are not compared with MATLAB v1.0 numbers.

Task T4b - Stage-2 floors from the kernel, both modes. Specification: the plan section '### T4b' and the contract item F8 (implemented by T4b) with the items it consumes (F1-F7 through the SK stand-ins until J1); your base is T4a's accepted branch. Each floor is the true density of its module with a t_min normal shell and air (UHPC t_min 76.2 mm, thin shell 25.4 mm), computed on the kernel's bodies; floors stay inside the T0d cached block. Test on the stand-ins against closed forms; on C1 print the floors per module for both modes once the real kernel is merged (J1). T4b merges after J1. No whole-pipeline run.

Task T2a - geometry kernel, exact path (critical path to T3). Specification: the plan section '### T2a' and the contract items T2a implements: S1, S1b, S2, S2r, F1 (exact path: exact NURBS of the .ms2 entities, F1 orders the parameter z depends on as u, constant-z splits, splits at patch-corner heights, the same-curve rule for shared boundaries, the deck check and its errors), F2 (normal offset of the exact surface by d = t + eps/2, fold trimming, crease split, adaptive cubic B-spline fit after Piegl and Tiller with knot insertion in failing spans and knot removal while metrics hold), F2b (d_close and t_max), F3, F3b, F4, and the metrics M1-M3 with eps = 0.01 * t_min (AGENTS section 5 item 9). Hand every patch that needs the general path to fit_z_faces, which T2b implements (T2a tests only decks with no general path). Tests: the C1 oracles of contract section 3 (smallest convex radius 0.100 m: no fold at 25.4 or 76.2 mm; fold from d = 0.100 m at the top arc and the neck ends), the SK cylinder (rims are creases: fold trimming and crease split), split_wall_box (F1 decisions only) and stepped_spar per the plan; M1-M3 checked on a dense grid not used for fitting; report pass counts and knots per face. Cache offset results per thickness as contract section 7 requires. Base e7e9114 (main with the amended contract). No whole-pipeline run.
